name: linkedin2username
summary: OSINT Tool: Generate username lists for companies on LinkedIn.
highlights: -c — Company name exactly as typed in the company linkedin profile page URL.
-n — Append a domain name to username output. [example: "-n uber.com" would output jschmoe@uber
-d — Search depth (how many loops of 50). If unset, will try to grab them all.
-s — Seconds to sleep between search loops. Defaults to 0.
-x — Proxy server to use. WARNING: WILL DISABLE SSL VERIFICATION. [example: "-p https://localho
-k — Filter results by a a list of command separated keywords. Will do a separate loop for each
-g — Attempts to bypass the 1,000 record search limit by running multiple searches split across

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --company
flags.description: Company name exactly as typed in the company linkedin profile page URL.

flags.name: --domain
flags.description: Append a domain name to username output. [example: "-n uber.com" would output jschmoe@uber.com]

flags.name: --depth
flags.description: Search depth (how many loops of 50). If unset, will try to grab them all.

flags.name: --sleep
flags.description: Seconds to sleep between search loops. Defaults to 0.

flags.description: Filter results by a a list of command separated keywords. Will do a separate loop for each keyword, potentially bypassing the 1,000 record limit. [example: "-k 'sales,human resources,information technology']
